messages:
Emma Nguyen: Quick heads-up — we're doing a final pass on the webinar battlecard and the launch posts. Need crisp competitive hooks vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Can we sync on one-page soundbites + routing for inbound leads?

Raj Patel: SGTM. My priority: tighten the benchmark narrative so sales can call out predictable tail latency and token cost per 1k as a repeatable claim. one-liners + 2 quick numbers.

Sofia García: Agree. Also we should pre-empt the "managed vs self-hosted" objection — lead with unified runtime + predictable economics. Competitors will hammer "model access" and "fully managed" as simplicity wins.

Liam Chen: For routing: any lead mentioning "latency" or "SLA" -> Prod Sales AE + Solutions. Mentions of "on-prem" or "VPC" -> Enterprise AE + Security SE. Mentions of "cost" or "ops" -> Midmarket AE + Platform SE.

Emma Nguyen: Nice. Can we make those rules explicit in the playbook so SDRs can copy/paste? Also need 3 battlecard snippets (cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors) that are short, defensible, and actionable for SDRs.

Raj Patel: Draft snippets: 
- Cloud AI platforms: "We match the convenience of hosted APIs but give you predictable unit economics and multi-environment routing — so apps don’t hit surprise bills when scale spikes."
- LLM APIs: "Open model + runtime-aware optimizations mean you get improved cost/latency without rebuilding serving infra."
- Infra vendors: "We provide a production-grade serving runtime + orchestration layer out of the box — less infra glue, more predictable SLOs."

Sofia García: Those are good starts. Tweak the language to include proof hooks: e.g., for Cloud AI platforms add: "benchmark: 99th pctl < X ms for 1k-token seqs in our hosted profile" (we'll fill numbers after bench run).

Liam Chen: On routing rules, propose a simple JSON that SDRs can paste into the routing UI. Example snippet for the playbook:
```
{
  "conditions": [
    {"field": "lead_text", "contains": ["latency", "SLA", "p99"] , "route_to": ["prod-sales@redwood.com"]},
    {"field": "lead_text", "contains": ["on-prem", "vpc", "air-gapped"], "route_to": ["enterprise@redwood.com"]},
    {"field": "lead_text", "contains": ["cost", "price", "token"], "route_to": ["midmarket@redwood.com"]}
  ]
}
```

Emma Nguyen: Perfect — add a fallback bucket: "general-inbound" with a tickbox for follow-up cadence. Also include a short guidance note: SDRs should always ask "Are you optimizing for latency, cost, or security?" as the opening question.

Sofia García: Messaging iteration note: let's A/B test two openers in the webinar follow-up email:
A) "How much could you save on tokens with runtime-aware batching?"
B) "Can your current provider meet 99th-pctl latency under burst?"
Measure MQL->SQL conversion over 2 weeks.

Raj Patel: Benchmarks: I'll run a 3-profile sweep (short-chat, user-assist mid-length, long-context generation) and export p50/p95/p99 + cost/token estimates. ETA EOD tomorrow.

InboundRouterBot: New lead routed -> route: enterprise@redwood.com, score: 78, matched keywords: ["on-prem", "compliance"]

Liam Chen: One more tactical: include competitive rebuttals as bullet lines SDRs can paste. Example for "managed-only" claim: 
- "Managed solutions are easier at first — but when costs spike or data rules tighten, you want a single runtime that can move between hosted, dedicated, and private without re-architecting. That's what we ship."

Emma Nguyen: Love it. Final asks before I lock the doc: a) Raj — attach the benchmark numbers b) Sofia — 3 prioritized rebuttals per competitor c) Liam — routing JSON + example Slack alert for routed enterprise leads d) Everyone — 1 quick quote (<= 10 words) that sales can use in calls.

Sofia García: I'll drop the rebuttals and the 10-word quote in this thread by noon.

Raj Patel: Bench run started, will post CSV + the short callouts when it's done.

Liam Chen: I'll add the Slack alert template: `@prod-sales new enterprise lead: {lead_id} — keywords: {kw}, score: {score}`. Pushing to playbook in ~30m.

Emma Nguyen: Thanks team — I'll synthesize into final battlecard and share the draft for a quick sign-off. :rocket:
